name: md-hinagata
description: Themeable Markdown to HTML Studio for VS Code.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run check && cargo check --workspace
scripts.lint: biome check . && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm run test:github-scripts && pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:rust && pnpm run test:coverage:vitest
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:packaged: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run test:e2e:packaged
